description: NaCoF₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.74 Å. Co is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing CoF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-37°. All Co-F bond lengths are 2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two equivalent Co atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Co atoms to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₂Co₂ trigonal pyramids.
